paragraphs.text: Capability self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: measures what skills really deliver, injects the
measured truth before use, and corrects skill descriptions overnight with backups and revert.
# Dreaming · consciousness strength
中文 | English
> Knowing what a skill can actually do *before* you execute it — that is **consciousness strength**.
Dreaming raises it by measuring every skill call and correcting skill boundaries overnight, so skil
ls are invoked precisely and tokens are not wasted on descriptions that merely *look* right.
Dreaming is a global DeepSeek Harness plugin (Host plugin + Web panel). It is not a logging plugin;
it is a **capability self-model**:
- every skill load is **concurrently probed** with a cheap model call that predicts what the skill c

an really deliver for this task;
- what actually happened after the load is recorded (did the model

follow the skill, abandon it, redo the work, how many tokens did it cost);
- at the end of the turn

a **judge** compares expectation with reality and extracts reusable rules;
- each skill keeps a dura

ble **capability belief** and a single consciousness score;
- the measured truth is injected before

use (historical accuracy, boundaries, cheaper alternatives);
- a **nightly dream** revisits mismatch
es and safely edits skill descriptions and boundary sections (backups, journal, revertible), improvi
ng precision at the source.
## Why it exists
A skill description is a *claim*. Claims and reality often disagree:

- the description promises X, the body only covers a subset of X;
- the description is too broad, so

the model loads it when it should not, and the whole body becomes context cost;
- the description i

s too narrow, so the model bypasses the skill and redoes the work, wasting more tokens;
- the same t
ask keeps misusing the same skill, and nothing writes that lesson back into the description.
Dreaming closes the loop: **measure → judge → write the boundary back → measure again**. The metric
is rising consciousness and falling wasted tokens, not the number of log lines.
## How it works

### 4. Capability belief and consciousness
Each skill keeps a belief: load count, verdict distribution, fit history, cost, learned boundaries.
eps a belief: load count, verdict distribution, fit history, cost, learned boundaries. Core metrics:
| Metric | Definition | Question it answers |
| `fitAccuracy` | `1 − Brier score` (predicted fit vs. actual success) | Does it predict *itself* ac

curately? |
| `boundaryAccuracy` | `1 − share of judged calls with a capability gap` | Is its stated

boundary accurate? |
| `precision` | `1 − misapplied / judged` (judged calls only) | When it was ca

lled, was it on topic? |
| `consciousness` | `100 × (0.45·fitAccuracy + 0.30·boundaryAccuracy + 0.25

·precision)` | The combined consciousness score |
| `wasteRate` | wasted tokens / loaded skill token

s | How much did it waste? |
| `confidence` | `<3 / <10 / ≥10 judged` → low / medium / high | How tr
ustworthy is the score? |
> No fake high score with few samples: `confidence = low` is reported, and both the panel and the mo

del-facing text say so.
>
> Waste accounting: a call judged `misapplied` or `missed` counts its whol
e skill-body cost as wasted; `partial` only counts rework tokens when rework was actually observed.
### 6. Dream — correct the capability description overnight
`dream.time` (default `03:30`, local time zone, configurable IANA zone) triggers a run; catch-up and

## Data and privacy
- Data directory: `$DSH_HOME/dreaming/` (`episodes.jsonl`, `state.json`, `dreams.json`, `edits.json`

, `backups/`);
- only compressed evidence is stored: task goals, conversation excerpts, tool-sequenc
e summaries, judgements; no full prompts, no raw model output; episode records do not store the full

skill body;
- to support revert, `edits.json` stores the full pre-edit text and sha256 of **the one
skill file this plugin modified** (in the local data directory only; never sent to a model, never s

hown in the panel/API);
- probe and judge content is sent to the model provider currently configured

, exactly like normal conversation; no extra network requests;
- before a skill edit, a byte backup

is written to `backups/<editId>/SKILL.md`; `edits.json` records the before/after sha256;
- logs cont
ain no prompt text; even at `debug` level only lengths and timings are logged.
## Known limitations
- **No edits by default**: `dream.autoApply` is `false`, so dreams journal proposals without touchin
g files. Enable it explicitly to correct descriptions/boundaries (backups, journal, conflict detecti

on and revert still apply).
- **Suggestions need samples**: the first calls of a new skill show only

low-confidence hints; the plugin deliberately never fabricates a high score without evidence.
- **N
on-editable sources**: bundled / project / runtime skills can only improve through the injected guid

ance overlay; their files are never rewritten.
- **Capability edits are heuristic**: dream proposals
pass deterministic validation, but a “better description” can still introduce bias; that is why bac

kups, journal, conflict detection and single-step revert exist.
- **Dream is inline-only in v1**: th
e night usually has no live parent agent; `dream.mode` is recorded truthfully as `inline` and logs o

ne warning.
- **Symlinks are not edited**: if a skill's `SKILL.md` is a symlink the plugin refuses t
o write (`symlink-path`) and only records a suggestion, so the link is never replaced by a regular f

ile.
- **Local trust boundary**: `/dreaming/api/` has no extra auth beyond the loopback binding (POS
T has an Origin check). Do not expose the profile's listener on a non-loopback address without addin

g authentication, and treat the data directory and backups as local user data.
- **`POST /dreaming/a
pi/dream/run` runId**: the run is asynchronous; the call returns `accepted:true` immediately and `ru

nId` may be `null` — the actual run id is in the next journal refresh.
- **Judge quality depends on

the model**: scores are relative signals for trends and prioritization, not absolute truth.
- **Suba
gent overhead**: by default both probe and judge run as caller-delivered child sessions, which costs
significantly more than inline and is subject to delegation depth/capacity; any failure falls back
ntly more than inline and is subject to delegation depth/capacity; any failure falls back to inline.
